items.title: What Does Hormel Foods (HRL) Pork Price Fixing Lawsuit Mean For Investors?
items.summary: Hormel Foods (NYSE: HRL) has been named as a defendant in a major antitrust class action lawsuit alleging price fixing in the U.S. pork industry. The case claims a conspiracy among several pork producers to coordinate and inflate prices for pork products sold across the country. Some co-defendants have reached settlements, while legal proceedings involving Hormel Foods and others are continuing in court. items.title: 1 Consumer Stock on Our Buy List and 2 We Ignore
items.summary: Regarded as defensive investments, consumer staples stocks are generally safe bets in choppy markets. The flip side is that they frequently fall behind growth industries when times are good, and this perception became a reality over the past six months as the sector was down 5.7% while the S&P 500 was up 8.3%.
